title: Battle of Abancay
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Abancay", at revision 1370430763, opens: "The Battle of Abancay took place during the Spanish conquest of Peru. Alonso de Alvarado, sent by Francisco Pizarro to relieve the siege of Cusco, was camped at Jauja with five hundred men. He guarded the bridge and a ford on the Rio de Abancay, awaiting Almagro’s men. However, the soldier Alvarado placed in command of the ford, Pedro de Lerma, deserted, allowing Almagro to capture Alvarado’s force almost intact." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q283288, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1537 battle that took place during the Spanish conquest of Peru". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
